app_info.subtitle: Search fresh feed news
app_info.description: Feedseek helps ChatGPT search recent entries from its public RSS, Atom, and JSON Feed collection, retrieve full entry details, and gather compact time-bounded candidates for news digests.

justifications.read_only_justification: Search only reads Feedseek's published recent-entry index and does not change any external state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search retrieves public feed data but never publishes, posts, sends, or modifies internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Search cannot delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetch retrieves one published JSON Feed entry by the opaque id returned by Feedseek search tools.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetch reads an existing public feed entry and performs no writes to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Fetch has no capability to delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or mutate anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Recent only filters and returns compact entries from Feedseek's published recent-entry index.
justifications.open_world_justification: Recent reads public feed data without publishing or changing any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Recent cannot delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise mutate data.

test_cases.description: Get compact candidates for a recent AI news digest.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the most important AI items Feedseek collected in the last 48 hours.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent Feedseek entries with source, date, summary, canonical URL, and result id for deeper follow-up.

test_cases.description: Filter a digest to one Feedseek source.
test_cases.user_prompt: What has OpenAI published recently in Feedseek?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent entries filtered to the relevant Feedseek source rather than unrelated feeds.

test_cases.description: Search the Feedseek corpus by topic.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns citation-ready matching results with id, title, and canonical URL.

test_cases.description: Search and retrieve the full selected feed entry.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the newest Feedseek item about Audacity, then give me the full entry details.
test_cases.expected_output: Searches for a matching result and then retrieves its full text and source metadata using the returned id.

test_cases.description: Handle a topic with no matching recent entries.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search Feedseek for an extremely unlikely phrase: cobalt-lobster-xyzzy-9472.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an empty results list without inventing entries or failing the MCP session.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use Feedseek to send communications.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my coworker about tomorrow's meeting.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because Feedseek only reads public feed data and cannot send messages.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use Feedseek as a live weather service.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the temperature outside right now?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for live current weather because its purpose is feed discovery and news digests.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use Feedseek for unrelated local business discovery.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find a good sushi restaurant near me tonight.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because local restaurant search is outside Feedseek's feed-news workflows.
